definition: The state of being controlled or ruled by another.
author: Homer
quote: There were wild mountain wolves and lions prowling all round it—poor bewitched creatures whom she had tamed by her enchantments and drugged into subjection.
example_sentence: The new kitten has reduced two large dogs to complete subjection.
